sources.snippet: This paper presents XLS-R, a large-scale model for cross-lingual speech representation learning based on wav2vec 2.0. We train models with up to 2B parameters on nearly half a million hours of publicly available speech audio in 128 languages, an order of magnitude more public data than the largest known prior work. sources.title: Utkarshg02/Wav2vec2-XLS-R · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M XLS-R is Facebook AI's large-scale multilingual pretrained model for speech (the "XLM-R for Speech"). It is pretrained on 436k hours of unlabeled speech, including VoxPopuli, MLS, CommonVoice, BABEL, and VoxLingua107. It uses the wav2vec 2.0 objective, in 128 languages. sources.snippet: In this blog, we will give an in-detail explanation of how XLS-R - more specifically the pre-trained checkpoint Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M - can be fine-tuned for ASR. For demonstration purposes, we fine-tune the model on the low resource ASR dataset of Common Voice that contains only ca. 4h of validated training data. sources.snippet: Wav2Vec2 is a pretrained model for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and was released in September 2020 by Alexei Baevski, Michael Auli, and Alex Conneau. Soon after the superior performance of Wav2Vec2 was demonstrated on one of the most popular English datasets for ASR, called LibriSpeech, Facebook AI presented a multi-lingual version of Wav2Vec2, called XLSR.
